description: Solid-sorbent (silica-gel / water) adsorption chiller driven by low-grade heat (60–95 C). COP_c = f(T_hot, T_cool, T_chilled) via reversible cascade times an adsorption-cycle quality factor.

unit.name: Generic 50 kW_th silica-gel/water adsorption chiller
unit.source: Saha, B.B., Boelman, E.C., Kashiwagi, T. (1995). Heat Recovery Systems & CHP 15, 581-590; Wang, R.Z., Oliveira, R.G. (2006). Prog. Energy Combust. Sci. 32, 424-458; Herold, Radermacher & Klein (2016).

carnot_fraction.note: Effective fraction of reversible cooling COP for silica-gel cycle
